name: gizza-ai/image-format-validator
summary: Verify an image's real format against its claimed type and check for corruption

tool.description: Validate an image without uploading it: detect the TRUE format from its magic bytes (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/TIFF/ICO), fully decode it to catch corrupt or truncated files, and report dimensions, megapixels, aspect ratio, colour type, bit depth, channel count, alpha channel, and file size. Optionally pass a claimed_format (or rely on the filename extension) to flag spoofed/mislabelled files where the extension disagrees with the real bytes. Returns a structured verdict (valid, matches_claim, corruption) and never throws on bad input. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

claimed_format.description: Format the file claims to be, to check the bytes against (spoof/mismatch detection). Use 'auto' (default) to fall back to the filename extension.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
